subject: SIG questionnaire: tailored control-pack + evidence delivery plan
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lynxinsure.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Lynx Insure Procurement <procurement@lynxinsure.com>, audits@lynxinsure.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG questionnaire: tailored control-pack + evidence request

Kim,

Thanks for taking the time on the vendor call yesterday. Attached is our accelerated SIG bundle — we condensed to 120 core controls for the underwriter review. Can Redwood provide:

- A control mapping (SIG-to-Redwood control ID) with owner for each control.
- Evidence deliverables: what artifacts you can provide vs. what we should validate during the onsite (if required).
- Proof points for KMS ownership, key rotation, and HSM usage for Private deployments.
- Confirmation of logging retention windows and access to raw audit logs for a 90-day retention audit.

Our timeline is tight: initial packet required by EOD Friday (2027-07-23) so our InfoSec can review before underwriting. If you have a portal we prefer a link; otherwise email ZIPs are OK.

Attachments: lynx_sig_questionnaire_2027.xlsx (primary worksheet)

Best,
Oliver Hayes
Head of Vendor Risk\Lynx Insure

---

(On Wed, Jul 21, 2027 at 09:05, Procurement <procurement@lynxinsure.com> wrote:)
> Kim — we flagged Redwood as priority. Happy to fast-track doc review if you can commit to timeline.
> 
> - Lynx Procurement

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire: tailored control-pack + evidence request

Team — forwarding Lynx's accelerated SIG bundle (attached). Key asks and constraints: EOD Friday turnaround, wants KMS/HSM proof (private option), 90-day raw audit log access confirmation, and a control mapping CSV.

Immediate plan suggestion (please confirm feasibility):
1) Karthik: lead control mapping CSV (SIG control -> Redwood control ID) and flag any controls requiring "on-prem / private-only" evidence by EOD Thu.
2) Neha: pull the SOC 2 one-pager + signed report link, and prepare the KMS key-rotation matrix (kms_key_rotation_matrix.xlsx).
3) Marissa: compile the evidence bag links (drive) and short descriptions; include sample logs and the audit-log retention policy excerpt.
4) I will own the cover note and final ZIP + portal session creation.

If any control requires an onsite demo or third-party attestation beyond SOC2/ISO artifacts, call it out explicitly. We should also offer their team a 30-minute evidence-portal walkthrough (screen share).

Attachments: lynx_sig_questionnaire_2027.xlsx (from client)

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Comms\Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire: tailored control-pack + evidence request

Team — draft status and blockers below. I started the mapping CSV (attached: sig-control-pack-lynx.csv). Highlights:

- ~95 controls are directly mappable to existing Redwood artifacts (SOC 2 + ISO + internal runbooks).
- ~18 controls reference customer-segregation items that only apply to Private deployments (we can mark these as "Private-only evidence").
- 7 controls relate to long-term retention/archive (we can provide policy + S3 lifecycle docs; for raw log retrieval we need to confirm access method).

Open questions for Oliver:
A) For the "raw audit logs" ask — do you need read-only streaming access to our logging pipeline or periodic bulk exports (e.g., 7z of the window)? We can provide both but need to know preferred format.
B) Will Lynx accept SOC 2 attestations + log samples for a subset of controls, or do you require cryptographic proof (e.g., KMS attestations via HSM vendor certs)?

I attached: sig-control-pack-lynx.csv (draft), and a short mapping notes tab.

Next steps: we can assemble the ZIP and upload to the evidence portal tomorrow morning. If they want a portal walkthrough we'll schedule Fri morning.

Attachments: sig-control-pack-lynx.csv

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Assurance & Onboarding\Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lynxinsure.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Lynx Insure Procurement <procurement@lynxinsure.com>, audits@lynxinsure.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 08:19:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: tailored control-pack + evidence request

Karthik / Kim — this is great, thanks. A few clarifications so we can sign off quickly:

1) Raw logs: prefer periodic bulk exports (encrypted tar.gz) plus a streaming option as backup. Please provide a sample export (one-day window) and the format spec.
2) KMS: we require HSM-backed key attestations for any Private deployment keys. For hosted models we are fine with cloud KMS if you provide key rotation cadence and access controls.
3) Could you provide a short cover memo that maps SIG control to the artifact type (e.g., SOC2 attestation, runbook excerpt, export sample) — that helps our reviewers.

If you can push the sample export + cover memo and SOC2 summary by EOD today, we will accept the packet and proceed to underwriting. Also happy to take a 30-min portal demo Fri 10:00 AM ET.

Oliver Hayes
Head of Vendor Risk\Lynx Insure

Attachments requested: sample_log_export_day1.tar.gz (placeholder — please upload), cover_memo_for_lynx.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lynxinsure.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: tailored control-pack + evidence request

Oliver — thanks for the quick turn. Deliverables uploaded and summary below. Portal link and ZIP attached.

Delivered (links / attachments):
- Evidence portal session: https://app.redwood.com/evidence-portal/session/0a1b2c3d (read-only bundle for Lynx Insure)
- ZIP (cover + artifacts): https://drive.re/redwood/lynx-evidence-pack-2027
  * redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf — SOC 2 opinion, scope & effective date (page refs called out in CSV).
  * sig-control-pack-lynx.csv — SIG control -> Redwood control ID, evidence type, owner, delivery method column.
  * kms_key_rotation_matrix.xlsx — rotation cadence, KMS provider per environment, HSM attestations (for Private deploys).
  * sample_log_export_day1.tar.gz (stub) — sample export exported as encrypted tar (we prepared a redacted sample for PII safety).

Quick answers to your clarifications:
- Log exports: we provided a redacted example in the ZIP. Format: gzipped JSON lines, each event has ISO timestamp, request_id, model_id, token_count, and audit_context. We can provide either bulk exports or a streaming S3 read role depending on your ingestion preference.
- KMS/HSM: for Private deployments we can provide HSM vendor attestations and exportable key metadata; for Hosted we use cloud KMS with monthly rotation by default and automated rotation policy (details in matrix).
- Cover memo: uploaded as "cover_memo_for_lynx.pdf" inside the ZIP. It maps SIG control -> artifact type and indicates where to find the page/section in the SOC 2 summary or runbook.

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether you prefer bulk export cadence (daily/week) or a streaming S3 role so we can provision a read-only role.
- We have scheduled the portal walkthrough for Fri 10:00 AM ET as suggested; meeting invite to follow.

If you need additional signed attestations (e.g., vendor HSM certs) we'll route via Marissa — she has the vendor pack.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Comms\Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf, kms_key_rotation_matrix.xlsx, sig-control-pack-lynx.csv, cover_memo_for_lynx.pdf
